references.text: Noah offers to God after the flood, and God finds pleasure in the offering, similarly as He found pleasure in Abel's offering.
The fat belongs to the Lord – a connection to Abel offering from the fat (chelev) of his firstborn.
Firstborn of small livestock are holy to the Lord, relevant to Abel's offering of firstborn from the flock.
The principle of honoring the Lord with the best of one's harvest, as Abel offered from the firstborn and their fat.
Abel is mentioned as an example of faith; by faith he brought a better offering than Cain, and received testimony that he was righteous.
Cain killed his brother because his own deeds were evil, but his brother's were righteous – Abel is presented as righteous.
